instruction: Open the FlightAware flight tracking map view.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the flight tracking map page on FlightAware. Simple navigation task with similar difficulty to original. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement
Getter (get_active_tab_info) extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree, which is the appropriate state for verifying navigation
Metric (is_expected_active_tab) compares actual URL against expected URL using compare_urls function
Expected URL 'https://www.flightaware.com/live/map' is semantically correct - the /live/map path is indeed the flight tracking map view on FlightAware
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL → metric compares → returns 1.0 if match, 0.0 otherwise
Metric function correctly handles 'expected' parameter (not 'expected.get(rules)') as required for type='rule'
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (navigate to map view) is fully verified
Practical feasibility: accessibility tree can reliably extract active tab URL, and URL comparison is robust
